description: Send a private, signed message to a shielded BitcoinZ address (zs), inside an encrypted shielded transaction. It carries 0.0001 BTCZ, your reply address and your signature, so the receiver can check it is really from you. Max about 330 bytes of text. Shielded on the blockchain. Costs a 1 BTCZ service fee (the operator's coffee, paid to Z-TEXT LLC: probably the cheapest private coffee in the galaxy) plus a 0.0001 BTCZ network fee. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet). Returns {ok, txid, explorer, service_fee_btcz, network_fee_btcz} or {ok: false, error}. Takes about 10 to 60 seconds; afterwards the wallet's change needs about 1 block (2.5 minutes) before the next send.

to.description: Shielded BitcoinZ address of the receiver (starts with zs)

name: send_message
